entries.change: Initialized MAX Grounding Phase 0 governed cross-platform baseline.
Phase 1 candidate adds bounded grounding contracts, hard two-call search budget, canonical evidence deduplication, and fail-closed evidence status.
Phase 2 candidate adds the stdlib-only SearXNG live-search provider, bounded non-redirecting JSON HTTP handling, conservative result-URL admission, and 12-job cross-platform runtime evidence.
Phase 2 accepted on main after exact-PR Acceptance and post-merge main revalidation both passed STRICT governance and the full 12-job cross-platform runtime matrix.

Phase 3 candidate adds secure DNS-all-answer validation, IP-pinned HTTP(S) result-page fetching, bounded fail-closed response handling, safe text extraction, security regression coverage, frozen-plan conformance, and final 12-job cross-platform evidence.
Phase 3 accepted on main after exact-PR Acceptance and post-merge main revalidation both passed STRICT governance and the full 12-job Linux/Windows/macOS Python 3.11-3.14 matrix.

Phase 4 candidate adds deterministic Unicode tokenization, bounded overlapping text chunks with stable provenance, in-memory BM25 lexical ranking, hard retrieval caps, frozen-plan conformance, and 12-job cross-platform evidence.
Phase 4 accepted on main after exact-PR Acceptance and post-merge main revalidation both passed STRICT governance and the full Linux/Windows/macOS Python 3.11-3.14 matrix.
